classify.fast.description: Low-cost enum classification with a grammar-friendly local first candidate.

candidates.reason: Small local classification role; the enum grammar carries most of the constraint.
Hosted classification fallback when the local resource is unavailable.
Subscription-backed metered fallback when local and operator BYOK routes are unavailable.

extract.structured.description: Schema-constrained extraction with a mid-size local first candidate.

candidates.reason: Mid-size local generation role; the gateway validates every returned value locally.
Hosted structured-output fallback for schemas the local resource cannot reliably produce.

judge.default.description: Deterministic rubric evaluation with a local-first candidate and hosted fallback.

candidates.reason: Local judge keeps rubric decisions available without a network dependency.
Hosted structured-output fallback when the local judge is unavailable.

locate.visual.description: Visual grounding that returns canonical target bounds and confidence without exposing provider coordinates.

candidates.reason: Local-first grounding keeps captured frames on the device and uses the measured vision model ladder.
Hosted multimodal grounding fallback for hosts without an available local vision rung.
